question: How is the lower knower called sakala further divided into multiple states?
premises: The lower knower is called sakala.
This sakala knower is distinguished by divisions such as higher-lower and so on.
Even this sakala knower has a manifold state.
inference: Therefore the sakala, though defined as the lower knower, is itself internally differentiated into many modes.
plain_english: The lower knower is indeed called the sakala. Yet even he has a manifold state, distinguished by divisions such as higher-lower and so on.
